column1: # One row per suite: the tag names tests/<tag>.bats, or tests/<tag>-test.sh
# while that suite is still a shell one, and the patterns are the changed paths
# that select it. Every row a path matches counts, in any order, so one path can
# select several suites; a changed suite claims itself without a pattern.
# `all` runs every suite and `none` runs none; a path no row claims is `all`.
# The harness decides what runs, so a change to it changes any result: `all`.
